title: Hoydich Estates — the family fork
dek: The flower movement forked itself: family charter, Tezos door, honor roll
body: Two days after publishing The Flower Standard — the investor-grade blueprint for winning flower legalization and buying the craft farms the crash is orphaning — we forked our own manifesto. Same plant, same law, same five years; different constitution. Hoydich Estates is the family version: four seats with our names on them, a public Tezos treasury, contributions as patronage with soulbound honors instead of yield promises, and machines running the paperwork while humans keep the keys. The Door is open now. Cast tez with a one-line dedication: the record is append-only, your standing is soulbound, and every mutez forwards to the treasury in the same operation. v0.1 runs on Shadownet with the mainnet opening to follow. The two versions now compete on a public scoreboard — estates held, farmers protected, participants enrolled, laws moved. May the better constitution win; the plant wins either way.
